what: Plan 9 (design of 2026-11-11: earlier models and transfer; approved 2026-11-11 with 32 target cities): methods fixed before the source pre-run; the opponents are chosen by `opponent_rule` from the source pre-run and written once to results/multicity/p9/opponents.json before any target-city result.

opponent_rule.statistic: median share over the 35 source cities, validation block, leave-one-city-out
opponent_rule.fit: highest at level local among all earlier-model versions (Kwon included)
opponent_rule.zero_shot: highest at level uniform among the versions that do not need the city's own trips (Kwon excluded)
opponent_rule.fit_original: as fit, among the as-published versions only (population mass, and Kwon)
opponent_rule.zero_shot_original: as zero_shot, among the as-published versions only
opponent_rule.ties: fewer free parameters, then the name

contrasts.judgement: paired share difference by target city; "better" = the city-bootstrap 95% interval of the median difference lies above 0 and the contrast passes Holm over C1-C4; "worse" symmetric; otherwise "no distinguishable difference". Descriptive contrasts get no verdict.

failures: no finite NLL = failure: share -inf in the quantiles, a loss in a paired comparison, a tie when both sides fail

regression.against: results/multicity/p9_spike/transfer_scored.parquet (the 2026-11-11 spike, same cities and block as the source pre-run)

notes: Guo et al. 2026 (strexp1): d in km; the paper gives no unit, and the relaxed form strexp3 has a free scale.

Kwon et al. 2023: maximum likelihood here instead of the paper's per-pair OLS; groups and masses use the city's own training-period volumes, so its uniform/size/form rows carry only the exponents and intercepts over.
POI-count versions: both ends and the intervening opportunities for rad, ext_rad, io, pwo, ops; the destination only for the gravity, stretched-exponential and Cabanas-Tirapu forms.
form level: constants clipped to the donors' 5%-95% order statistics (not interpolated) before the ridge.
